arithmetic: CPU PyTorch float32 with independent float64 arithmetic checks

models.operation: Layer 0 selective state-space update over four controlled steps
models.scope: The prescribed x enters after convolution and SiLU. The prescribed z is the gate input. The trace covers the trained x and time-step projections, recurrence and gated readout before the final output projection. It begins with zero state and exposes all 16 modes of one channel.

A controlled 7 by 7 RGB tensor enters features.0. All 64 filters are evaluated at nine spatial positions. The complete patch operands are shown for filter 0, with every filter and bias available in the checkpoint.

models.operation: Two stages of residual vector quantization
models.scope: A controlled 128-dimensional vector enters the quantizer in the place of one encoder frame. The vector is a weighted blend of two first-stage codewords plus a deterministic perturbation. Each stage scores all 1024 learned 128-dimensional candidates. Stage 1 receives the residual after subtracting the stage 0 winner. All candidates are rows of the two stored codebook tensors.
models.score_rule: The native implementation maximizes negative squared Euclidean distance. The same code ID minimizes the squared distances reported here.
